role_split.cloud_run: stateless checkout, quote/order binding, verifier calls, payment finalization, signed entitlement grant
role_split.base44: low-volume payment ledger, invoice metadata, account entitlement mirror, user-visible payment history
role_split.oracle_cace: verify signed entitlement grant before paid scientific features execute
role_split.monero_verifier: authoritative receive-address/subaddress and chain/wallet payment confirmation source

cloud_run.payment_signing_private_key_location: Google Secret Manager or equivalent server-side secret injection only

supported_architecture_examples: BTCPay Server + community Monero plugin on persistent infrastructure
dedicated Monero wallet-RPC/payment verifier on persistent infrastructure
future reviewed merchant processor with authenticated server API/webhook
verifier.preferred_order_addressing: unique subaddress or verifier-issued unique invoice destination per order
verifier.confirmation_policy: configurable upward; never below operator-approved production threshold
verifier.note: BTCPay Monero support is community/plugin based rather than core BTCPay support.

quote.price_selection: SKU + tier + server-computed promotion schedule frozen at order creation

catalog_rule.collision_rule: Each active promotion applies only to its own SKU duration; discounts never stack on one SKU.
catalog_rule.enforcement: Cloud Run computes promotion eligibility and final price server-side; client-submitted promotion flags/prices are ignored/rejected.

triennial_year.payment_window_rule: Order creation and first verified payment sighting must occur inside the 24-hour America/Phoenix sale window; confirmations may complete afterward.

fulfillment.grant_rule: grant exactly the frozen order SKU after verified amount meets invoice and confirmation policy
fulfillment.duplicate_event_rule: idempotent no-op after same verified payment/order is finalized
fulfillment.refunds: manual/review workflow initially; no automatic Monero refund from Cloud Run

triennial_year_sale.stale_quote_rule: A year-pass quote created during the sale is not fulfillable at the sale price if the first verified payment sighting occurs after the 24-hour window.
triennial_year_sale.confirmation_rule: If first verified payment sighting occurred inside the sale window, required confirmations may complete later.
triennial_year_sale.underpayment_rule: Underpayment inside the window does not reserve the discounted entitlement beyond the window unless the invoice is fully satisfied before the window closes.

base44_payment_record.note: USD equivalent uses the frozen order price, not a later market value.

entitlement_grant.private_key_holder: Cloud Run payment service secret only
entitlement_grant.cace_rule: Oracle/CACE must verify signature, principal binding, validity interval and feature entitlement before paid capability execution.

entitlement_examples.basic_pass: unlock Basic features for purchased duration; promotions apply only when the server-side recurring schedule makes that SKU eligible; CPU multithreading still requires its separate perpetual unlock
entitlement_examples.researcher_pass: unlock Researcher features including CPU multithreading for purchased duration
entitlement_examples.enterprise_pass: unlock Enterprise/commercial features for purchased duration
entitlement_examples.basic_multithread_unlock: separate perpetual feature entitlement; excluded from recurring Tuesday/Saturday discount
entitlement_examples.enterprise_proof_package: separate order workflow; Monero may pay an approved invoice only after PROOF_READY_FOR_SALE / contract stage according to commerce policy

security: Never unlock from transaction ID supplied by browser without verifier confirmation.
Never expose wallet seed/spend key, payment signing private key, Base44 service credential or Oracle credential to browser.
Use constant-time/idempotent server-side finalization keyed by order/payment identity.
Do not let a user write their own Base44 payment or entitlement rows.
Log commerce provenance without storing unnecessary payer identity or inventing blockchain transparency that Monero does not provide.
Do not accept client-supplied promotion eligibility or discounted price; compute sale schedule and price server-side.
Triennial year-pass discount requires both order creation and first verified payment sighting within the configured 24-hour sale window.
compliance_note: Merchant/operator remains responsible for applicable tax, accounting, sanctions and other legal obligations; privacy features are not a mechanism to bypass them.
